== Stream API: eager vs lazy

[.track]
Intro · Problem · [.on]#Definitions# · Solutions · AI skills · Wrap-up

image::diagram-05-eager-lazy.svg[Eager steps vs a lazy chain,role=diagram]

* *Eager*: runs when called and returns a result.
* *Lazy*: recorded; runs one element at a time when a result is needed.
